sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: A RAG approach that uses graph relationships to gather context.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: Follow relevant connections, then explain them using their evidence.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: A tool’s related technology and supporting assertions can help explain its place in a project.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: Bounded graph reads and evidence access support a consuming agent. No additional Graph RAG framework is introduced.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Graph structure adds context that semantic similarity alone may not express.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: The term does not imply global graph summarization or an autonomous reasoning engine.
